source_acceptance: 21 chapters each contain ability goal/core model/deep explanation/application/pitfalls/tool card/exercise/reference answer
facts separated from interpretation; single cases never treated as universal causal proof
365 days each have theme/task/required output plus Day 30/90/180/270/365 gates
traditional health/divination chapters state modern evidence boundaries

major decision/5 Why/reversal/weekly review templates exist
